workflow: An application enables uninitialized-memory instrumentation but links a dependency built without compatible instrumentation.
During normal initialization, the application passes valid data into the dependency for processing.
An instrumented memory operation observes missing initialization metadata across the uninstrumented boundary and treats valid bytes as uninitialized.
The sanitizer aborts initialization and reports a false-positive uninitialized read instead of allowing the operation to complete.
summary: Partial instrumentation causes a false-positive uninitialized read during initialization
decision_reason: The failure mechanism materially matches the existing cluster: valid initialization crosses into an uninstrumented dependency, sanitizer metadata is unavailable, and an instrumented read is incorrectly reported as uninitialized.
